title: {M.V.O.} Modern Vanilla+ Overhaul
description: Cozy homesteading, exciting exploration, stunning visuals, Create technology, flowing fluids, and exceptional performance all included for a modern vanilla+ overhaul!!! <3 - KMV
body:
# **{M.V.O.} a Modern Vanilla+ Overhaul**

Experience an almost-vanilla feel designed to complement a homesteading and explorer playstyle, featuring performance improvements and visual enhancements from an edit to [***Fabulously Optimized***](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) and ***Complementary Shaders***, as well as various resource packs (including ***Fresh Animations***, ***Allure Dark Mode GUI***, ***3D Doors***, ***Hyper Punchy*** and more), in addition to many mods that alter gameplay such as ***Create***, ***Flowing Fluids***, ***Shoulder Surfing Reloaded***, ***First Person Model***, ***Soft Foliage*** and many more. Nearly 200 total mods, resource packs, and other projects included!

Due to the depth of the changes introduced it is more akin to a **Modern Vanilla+ Overhaul** especially so in the standard, intended configuration with the shaders, ***Voxy***, and many other small features combining. 

- **IMPORTANT:** Hardcore-Lite is included by default and means you lose a heart each time you die. Eat enchanted golden apples to gain hearts. Check the [***mod description***](https://modrinth.com/mod/hardcore-lite) for more details.
